engineer)

data, photos)

ranges in ( ); full sources: the spec JSON and research note named below.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Notes
Massing elevations: width = the long side of the outline's minimum rectangle,
height = the spec value with its tag; level lines only where a floor height is
published. Facade modules (precast grid, perforated screens, curtain walls)
are not dimensioned.
Garages A / G: the roof deck is still unmeasured; the drawn band is the spec
range: its 25 m lower end is what remains of the disputed "25-30 m" AirTrain-
photo reading (spec garage_a/g_height: DISPUTED), the upper end the helix drum
top. Grand Hyatt: no published height.
DOF points are drawn at their positions projected on the long side of each
outline's minimum rectangle (u from the end named on the elevation); the RCC
"TANK" is identified with the station stair / elevator tower only by inference
[inf].
